sv.title: Fortsatta problem med Microsofts molntjänster
sv.summary: Microsofts molnbaserade tjänster med bland annat Outlook och Teams har fortfarande tekniska problem i stora delar av världen. I Sverige ökar felrapporterna i antal kraftigt på morgonen och många kommuner har problem med mejlfunktionen.

en.title: Continued problems with Microsoft's cloud services
en.summary: Microsoft's cloud-based services, including Outlook and Teams, still have technical problems in large parts of the world. In Sweden the number of error reports rose sharply in the morning and many municipalities have problems with their email.
